reviews.title: Great value performance per dollar
reviews.comment: Very happy. Arrived packaged well. In the original box . Unopened. Was expecting a used one , but it looks brand new. I3 12100 with 16gbs and I get anywhere from 90 to 150 fps.  On star rupture . Plays everything with the latest driver update. I'm sure there are some games that don't work, but I haven't encountered one in my library yet. I will definitely be buy the 16 gb newer Intel card next upgrade.

reviews.title: blinking problem / problema parpadeo
reviews.comment: I used three monitors for work, 1600x900, 1920x1080, and 1600x900; nothing that these card should handle. This card shouldn't have issues with screen blinking. You're working normally, and suddenly the screens blink, all your windows get minimized, and you have to reopen them again; it's really annoying, and it happens more often for some reason while copying text. I've never had a device that needed so many updates. It's really common to turn on the PC and find an update for the ARC controller. Even with these frequent updates, the blinking problem isn't fixed. Tres monitores para trabajar: uno de 1600x900, otro de 1920x1080 y otro de 1600x900; nada que esta tarjeta no debería poder manejar. Esta tarjeta no debería presentar problemas con el parpadeo de las pantallas. Estás trabajando con normalidad y, de repente, las pantallas parpadean, todas tus ventanas se minimizan y tienes que volver a abrirlas; es realmente molesto, y, por alguna razón, sucede con más frecuencia al copiar texto. Nunca había tenido un dispositivo que necesitara tantas actualizaciones. Es bastante común encender la PC y encontrar una actualización para el controlador ARC. A pesar de estas actualizaciones frecuentes, el problema del parpadeo persiste.
reviews.author: sebastian
